reviewers.summary: The implementation adds the theme and renderer, but the named tests do not exercise the production root wiring or fully verify the theme and NFR-006 contracts. Each listed failure scenario can pass the current tests.

findingList.message: The test does not exercise the production root, so it cannot verify the theme selection and root-provider behavior required by this criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: FluentProvider_theme_selection_contract renders a standalone FluentProvider; it never renders AltivaneRoot from main.tsx.
evidence.failureScenario: If AltivaneRoot stops applying the stored choice, setting data-theme, or wrapping the app with exactly one provider, this test still passes because it sets those storage and document values itself.

findingList.message: The renderer tests do not cover the production root wiring. They cannot prove that the root reads the document nonce and applies it to the signed-in app’s Griffel styles.

evidence.codePathTraced: signed_in_shell_marks_every_griffel_style constructs a renderer directly with a hard-coded nonce and renders its own providers; it never calls AltivaneRoot or getRendererAttributes.
evidence.failureScenario: If AltivaneRoot ignores the nonce meta or omits the RendererProvider, this test still passes because its locally created renderer supplies the nonce.

findingList.message: The theme contract test does not assert every colour override required by the criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: Altivane_theme_contract asserts only a subset of the theme overrides in altivaneTheme.ts.
evidence.failureScenario: Changing colorBrandBackgroundHover, colorBrandBackgroundPressed, colorNeutralStroke1, or other unasserted overrides leaves this test passing, despite the criterion requiring every DD-003 colour override.

findingList.message: This test does not verify the NFR-006 source colour-literal or Fluent-token contract.

evidence.codePathTraced: Colour_literals_and_fluent_tokens_contract checks only manifest dependency names; it does not inspect files under frontend/src or styled component values.
evidence.failureScenario: Adding a hex colour literal outside altivaneTheme.ts, or hard-coded spacing or motion values in a styled component, does not change the manifest and the test still passes.

reviewers.summary: The dependency pin test checks its stated package versions, but several behavior criteria are represented by tests that bypass the app-root wiring or do not inspect the behavior they name. Those criteria can regress while the new tests still pass.

findingList.message: The test does not exercise the app-root theme selection required by the acceptance criterion. Render AltivaneRoot and assert its resolved theme, data-theme, and stored choice.

evidence.codePathTraced: The test renders FluentProvider directly and sets data-theme and localStorage itself; it never renders AltivaneRoot from main.tsx.
evidence.failureScenario: If AltivaneRoot stops resolving the selected theme, writing data-theme, or persisting only valid choices, this test still passes because it supplies the provider and stored values directly.

findingList.message: The test does not prove that styles produced through the signed-in app root receive the document nonce, as required by the acceptance criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: The style test creates its own renderer with a hard-coded nonce and renders its own RendererProvider and FluentProvider; it does not use the renderer or root wiring in main.tsx.
evidence.failureScenario: If the app root omits the nonce, fails to pass it to the renderer, or stops wrapping the signed-in app in RendererProvider, this test still passes using its independently configured renderer.

findingList.message: The named test does not cover the NFR-006 colour-literal and Fluent-token contract.

evidence.codePathTraced: Colour_literals_and_fluent_tokens_contract only filters manifest dependency names; it does not inspect frontend/src files or styling values.
evidence.failureScenario: Adding a new hex, rgb(), or hsl() colour literal outside altivaneTheme.ts, or adding raw spacing or font values instead of Fluent tokens, leaves the dependency list unchanged and the test passes.

reviewers.summary: No concrete security vulnerability is reachable in the changed code. The renderer accepts only the specified nonce shape and passes it to the root Griffel renderer.
